# heed

> Embeddable, no-install, framework-agnostic end-user feedback / bug-report / feature-request capability with a pluggable backend (standalone; optional enlace add-on)

- [heed.images](_autosummary/heed.images.html.md): Neutralise uploaded screenshots before they are stored (issue #15).
- [heed.ingest](_autosummary/heed.ingest.html.md): The ingest layer — build a Report from a submission and route it to a sink.
- [heed.routing](_autosummary/heed.routing.html.md): Where a report goes: server-side site resolution and moderation (holding state).
- [heed.security](_autosummary/heed.security.html.md): Public-endpoint hardening (the ingest endpoint is unauthenticated and hostile).
- [heed.serving](_autosummary/heed.serving.html.md): Serve stored screenshots: a read-only route meant for its own origin (issue #19).
- [heed.sinks](_autosummary/heed.sinks.html.md): Sinks: pluggable report destinations (strategy pattern).
- [heed.sinks.base](_autosummary/heed.sinks.base.html.md): The sink abstraction — where a report goes (strategy pattern).
- [heed.sinks.github](_autosummary/heed.sinks.github.html.md): A sink that turns a report into a GitHub issue.
- [heed.sinks.store](_autosummary/heed.sinks.store.html.md): A sink that persists reports into a Mapping (the default, dependency-free sink).
- [heed.storage](_autosummary/heed.storage.html.md): Storage helpers — dol-backed stores for reports and binary attachments.
- [heed.widget](_autosummary/heed.widget.html.md): Serve the embeddable widget, and state the contract it is built against.
